jobs.title: What If Two Planets Collided?
jobs.description:
4.5 billion years ago, a planet the size of Mars called Theia smashed into Earth. The crash melted Earth's surface and blasted out the rubble that became our Moon - and pieces of Theia may still be buried deep inside Earth.

#space #whatif #moon #science #shorts
